title: Senior Accounts Executive - GST & Compliance
description:
Key Responsibilities Handle end-to-end GST compliance and related activities. Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST returns. Perform GST reconciliations, including purchase/sales data reconciliation and ITC reconciliation. Review GST data, identify discrepancies, and ensure timely corrections. Handle GST notices, queries, assessments and departmental communications. Manage GST registrations, amendments and related documentation. Ensure compliance with applicable GST rules, regulations, and timelines. Handle TDS compliance, returns, reconciliations, and related activities. Manage day-to-day accounting activities, including journal entries, invoices, ledger scrutiny, and reconciliations. Perform bank, vendor, customer, and ledger reconciliations. Assist with monthly closing, MIS, audits, and other finance-related activities. Coordinate with internal teams, clients, auditors, and consultants as required. Stay updated with changes in GST laws, notifications, and compliance requirements. 

 Preferred candidate profile 24 years of relevant experience in GST, taxation, and accounting. Strong practical knowledge of GST compliance and reconciliations. Good understanding of TDS and other statutory compliances. Strong accounting fundamentals with hands-on experience in day-to-day accounting. Experience in handling GST notices and related matters will be an added advantage. Good working knowledge of MS Excel and accounting software. Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills. B.Com/M.Com/CA Inter or relevant qualification preferred.

Key Skills: GST Filing,GST,Accounting,Filing,Senior,Compliance
